Bug_Explanation: The HelloWorld class is annotated with @Controller and @Scope("prototype"). Spring controllers should use the default singleton scope, not prototype, as it can cause performance issues by creating multiple instances unnecessarily.
Trigger_Explanation: The instantiation of HelloWorld in test cases triggers the bug due to the @Scope("prototype") usage in a @Controller class, which is indicated by the comment. The bug is triggered when the Spring framework attempts to handle the controller's instantiation and lifecycle.
